title: Junior Security Researcher
description: We're hiring a junior Security Researcher. Remote, 0 to 2 years of experience, reporting to our Director of Security and Compliance. This is a role for someone who, when an antivirus flags a file, wants to know which signature fired and whether it's right. You ask "how would I detect this?" and "how would I get around it?" in the same breath. What you'll own: - AV and AMTSO liaison. Track how security vendors classify our software, file false-positive disputes, pursue allowlisting, and keep code-signing reputation healthy. - Network detection research, both sides. Study how detection vendors classify traffic from our web access network, reproduce their methods, and recommend hardening. - Internal hardening. Vulnerability management, configuration hardening, and secure-by-default practices across our infrastructure. - Abuse and threat triage. Turn abuse signals into detections and policy. Internships, home labs, CTFs, and personal projects count as experience. Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, IP reputation, ASNs) and Python scripting matter more than certs. We will teach you the rest. Fully remote, unlimited vacation, health coverage, a $500 home-office stipend, and monthly budgets for learning and wellness.
